translations.web: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
translations.bsb: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
translations.kjv: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
translations.asv: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
